about: Models the app can load. Each file is a LiteRT (.tflite) model in this folder. To add the trained banknote model, copy its .tflite and label file here and add one entry (see README.md, 'Add a trained model').

models.name: YOLOv8-Nano (YOLOv8n)
models.source: Ultralytics yolov8n.pt (COCO), exported with Ultralytics 8.4.174: yolo export model=yolov8n.pt format=litert imgsz=320 (Linux, 2026-10-07)
models.note: Same architecture as the thesis model. The banknote model will be trained from yolov8n.pt and exported the same way.

models.name: EfficientDet-Lite0

download.license: None stated on Google's model page (checked 2026-10-07), so the file is not in this repository

models.note: The mobile version of the EfficientDet family. The thesis compares EfficientDet-D0, a larger member of the same family.
